title.narrative: Promoting Renewable Energy Based Mini Grids for Rural Electrification and Productive Uses

description.narrative: The mentioned project was approved by the Global Environment Facility in June 2012 for implementation by UNIDO, and is divided into four components: 1) Institutional financial, policy and regulatory framework 2) Assist private developers with feasibility studies 3) Technology demonstration, awareness raising and Capacity development 4) Project monitoring and evaluation. The project focuses on the reduction of GHG emissions through the promotion of renewable energy based rural mini-grids for productive uses and energy access in Chad.
